loginHint: Your session stays in memory. Sign in again after refreshing this page.
enrollmentHint: Activate a new account or finish a password reset with a one-time enrollment capability.
bootstrapHelp: Use an enrollment capability from your administrator or local password recovery. It expires after 15 minutes.
enrolled: Account activated. Sign in with your login name and new password.
loginFailed: Login failed. Check your credentials and account status.
requestFailed: Request failed. Check the controller URL, HTTPS connection and trusted Origin settings.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and retry.
transportDenied: Access denied. Remote management requires HTTPS and a trusted Origin.
forbidden: Your account cannot access this page.
readOnlyNotice: View only. Your account cannot apply changes on this page.
lastAdmin: The last active administrator cannot be disabled, demoted or deleted.
resetConfirm: Reset credentials for {{name}}? All their sessions, tokens, and inbound credentials will stop working.
lastAdminOrConflict: The last administrator is protected, or this login name is already in use.
tokenHint: Tokens grant only the selected scopes, limited by the owner's current role. Keep copied secrets in a secure secret store.
tokenValidation: Select at least one scope and a future expiry, or leave expiry empty.
rotateConfirm: Rotate this token? The old secret stops working immediately.
copyOnce: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again after closing this dialog.
passwordChangeConfirm: Changing your password immediately revokes your existing password, sessions, tokens, and inbound credentials. Continue to enrollment?
setupHint: Finish first-time setup. Copy the initialization code from this controller’s startup output, then choose your administrator login and password.
setupRestartHint: The code lasts 15 minutes. Restarting before setup completes replaces it; use the latest code. If it has expired, restart the controller.
setupComplete: Administrator created. Sign in with your chosen login and password.
setupFailed: This initialization code is invalid, expired, replaced or already used. Use the latest code from the controller’s startup output.
checkingController: Checking whether this controller needs first-time setup…
checkControllerHint: Check the controller address and connection, then retry.
endCurrentSessionConfirm: Sign out this session? You will return to the login screen.
oauthBindingHint: Choose a provider to open its authorization page and connect it to your current local account. Your password remains available.
unlinkConfirm: Disconnect {{provider}}? Sessions signed in with this provider will stop working.
oauthFailed: OAuth failed or was cancelled. Allow popups, check the application settings, and make sure this account is connected to a local user.
oauthUnavailable: OAuth sign-in is unavailable. You can still sign in with your password.
oauthSetupHint: Register an OAuth web application with each provider and enter its client ID, secret and exact callback URL. Remote callbacks require public HTTPS. For Google, configure the consent screen and test users if the app is in testing.
oauthKeepSecret: Leave blank to keep the existing secret
disableOAuthConfirm: Disable {{provider}} sign-in? Existing account connections are retained.
oauthReadyToBind: Application configured. Choose Connect GitHub or Connect Google below to authorize and connect your account.
oauthConfigureFirst: Configure an OAuth application using the application settings button above, then connect your administrator account here.
oauthAskAdmin: OAuth sign-in has not been configured by an administrator.
proxyCredentialsHelp: Create a separate credential for each device. Each credential can be revoked or rotated independently. The inbound must also allow its owner.
credentialScopeHelp: Leave a scope empty to allow every supported protocol or every inbound that authorizes this user.
proxyCredentialValidation: Enter a name and select permanent validity or a future expiry.
rotateProxyCredentialConfirm: Rotate this credential? Its current secret and active connections will stop working.
upstreamCredentialsHelp: Store credentials used by outbound nodes to connect to upstream servers. They are independent of local users. Existing secrets are never shown again.
deleteUpstreamCredentialConfirm: Delete this credential? Nodes referencing it will stop connecting until a valid credential is selected.
inboundUserAuthenticationHelp: Accept credentials belonging to selected users alongside the existing inbound password.
legacyPasswordRemainsValid: The existing username/password remains valid independently. An empty legacy password configuration does not allow anonymous access while user authentication is enabled.
mixedUserAuthenticationHelp: SOCKS4 is unavailable while user authentication is enabled. HTTP and SOCKS5 remain available.
emptyUserSelectionHelp: An empty selection admits no user credentials. Existing configured legacy credentials remain valid.
credentialReferenceHelp: Select a shared credential or enter credentials below. Selecting a shared credential clears the corresponding inline username/password.
revokeProxyCredentialConfirm: Revoke this inbound credential? Its active connections will also close.
deleteProxyCredentialConfirm: Delete this inbound credential permanently? Its secret will stop working and its active connections will close.

usage.title: User traffic and audit
usage.hint: Payload traffic is sampled once per second. Times and buckets use UTC; byte totals exclude transport overhead.
usage.loadFailed: Usage could not be loaded. Check access, the selected dates and retained history.
usage.timeHint: Active minutes count each user once per minute with observed traffic. Combined session duration adds parallel sessions and includes idle time; it is not human activity time.
usage.incomplete: Audit coverage is incomplete: {{dropped}} checkpoints dropped, or persistence is failing. Usage totals are tracked separately.
usage.topLimit: Up to 200 entries, ordered by traffic.
usage.auditHint: Metadata only. Each row is one session, not one HTTP request or UDP destination. Details show the credential, route and selected node.

reasons.credential_invalidated: Credential expired or revoked, user disabled, or inbound changed
reasons.process_restarted: Previous process ended without a final checkpoint
reasons.gateway_rejected: Gateway access rule rejected the request

usage.retentionHint: Retention cleanup runs in the background. Reducing retention can permanently remove older detail; lifetime totals remain.
usage.auditSearch: Filter by event, user ID or source

groups.title: Traffic groups
groups.help: Traffic groups control network policy membership. They do not grant management permissions. Membership changes disconnect affected traffic sessions.
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete group {{name}} and remove its memberships?
groups.conflict: The group changed or is still referenced. Refresh and review before saving again.

authenticationMode.title: Authentication mode
authenticationMode.mixedWarning: Mixed authentication also accepts independent shared credentials. User revocation cannot revoke a shared password.

identityConditions.help: Matches authenticated traffic identities. Missing or revoked identities never match a positive identity condition.

access.title: Traffic Access Policy
access.help: Authorize authenticated proxy traffic before routing. Management roles and traffic groups are independent.
access.reloadConfirm: Reload the active policy and discard this draft?
access.scopeHelp: Protected inbounds require a valid user credential, even with default allow. Anonymous and legacy shared authentication are denied. Other inbounds remain outside this policy; review every alternate listener.
access.allInbounds: Protect all inbounds, including Gateway listeners
access.scopeIds: Protected inbound IDs, separated by commas
access.orderHelp: First matching rule wins. Put explicit denies before broader allows. Conditions at the top level are OR; use AND to require identity and destination together. Multiple group memberships do not change rule order.
access.activateConfirm: Activate this policy now? Sessions that lose access will close.
access.conflict: The active revision changed. Your draft is retained. Reload and reconcile before saving.
access.valid: Draft is valid. The active policy is unchanged.
access.destinationHelp: Domains and CIDRs within this condition are OR. Use separate conditions inside AND to require both the original domain and the resolved IP. Exact domains and *.subdomain patterns are supported.
access.cidrs: Resolved IPs or CIDRs, one per line
access.previewHelp: Uses an active proxy credential and the currently active policy, not this draft. Supply the destination host:port and an explicit resolved IP; preview does not query DNS. Inspect another user only with user management permission. Inbound credential restrictions still apply at authentication.
access.status: Tracked sessions: {{sessions}} · Denied: {{denied}} · Revoked: {{revoked}} · Capacity rejections: {{capacity}}
